answer.reason: The verses tell what was done with the tent and what happened at it, beyond the summary's account of its pitching.

clauses.english: was where everyone who sought the LORD went out to him
clauses.quote: every one which sought the LORD went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation

clauses.english: was where the cloudy pillar descended and the LORD spoke with Moses face to face
clauses.quote: the LORD spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend

doubts: The summary already says Moses pitched it outside the camp, so the pitching is not a clause.
